Crossposted from https://github.com/nomeata/loogle/issues/57, I'll synchronize it if someone knows the solution.

If I run the command ./server.py --project-dir <git clone of https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/>, I get

Server started http://localhost:8088
failed to read file '<mathlib dir>/.lake/build/lib/lean/Mathlib.olean', incompatible header

What should be the proper command for running the server on the mathlib repo?

Instead of pointing --project-dir at mathlib, point it at a project that imports mathlib (example lakefile.toml). You may have to lake build or lake exe cache get inside the example to get the required oleans.

Note: This is only based on my very narrow understanding. It might be possible to get loogle to work inside a clone of mathlib as well.
This worked, thank you! I do wonder whether this is the expected method of use, I'd also be interesting in seeing whether we can run directly inside mathlib

Did you follow the following instructions from the README?

Copy the target project's lean-toolchain into this checkout, so the loogle binary is built with the same toolchain as the oleans it will read:

cp /path/to/project/lean-toolchain .

loogle can indeed be run directly on mathlib.
Ah, I had followed the instructions to use the non-server command line tool on another project and then did not update the toolchain when I targeted mathlib with the server. Thanks for the tip!
